name: Understand Anything
summary: Claude Code plugin that turns any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph dashboard you can search, tour and question.
description: A multi-agent pipeline scans a project, extracts every file, function, class and dependency, and builds a knowledge graph saved to .ua/knowledge-graph.json. A dashboard then shows it with guided tours, fuzzy and semantic search, architectural layers and diff-impact analysis; the graph can be committed so teammates open it without an LLM. Installs on Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Gemini CLI and more.
contains: pipeline: project scanner, file analyzer, architecture analyzer, tour builder, graph reviewer
structure from tree-sitter; summaries, layers and domains from LLMs
graph at .ua/knowledge-graph.json; commit it so teammates skip the pipeline
dashboard: search, guided tours, layer colour coding, diff impact, persona-adaptive detail
dashboard opens read-only with Node.js >= 18, no LLM or API key
installs on Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Copilot CLI, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kiro and more
output languages: en, zh, zh-TW, ja, ko, ru, vi
incremental re-analysis; /understand --auto-update patches the graph on commit
